business_summary: Taewoong Logistics Co., Ltd., a logistics company, provides various transport services by sea, air, bulk project, and inland transportation in South Korea and internationally. The company offers integrated logistics service, including export/import sea, air, railway, project transport, customs clearance, insurance, and loading and unloading services; and develops/operates logistics system through logistics information system, such as global logistics system, direct connection with customer's system, customized logistics system, and various EDI connection system. It also provides rail transport services to CIS regions, East Europe, Central Asia, and the Middle East; inland transport services; sea transport services comprising various types of deliveries that include FCL/LCL, OOG, DG cargo, ISO tank, and Flexi-bags; and air transport services for import and export cargo. In addition, the company transports equipment for overseas/domestic chemical plants, electric power plants, and infrastructure projects; and acts as ISO tank operators and cleaning depots. Further, it provides inland/logistics consulting services; multimodal transport services, such as railway, sea, inland, warehouse, and customs clearance professionals; and warehousing, logistics, and support services for cargo. The company was formerly known as Taewoong Shipping Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Taewoong Logistics Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: (주)태웅로지스틱스는 국내는 물론 해외까지 해상, 항공, 벌크 프로젝트, 내륙운송 등 다양한 운송 서비스를 제공하는 물류회사입니다. 수출입 해상, 항공, 철도, 프로젝트 운송, 통관, 보험, 하역 서비스 등 통합 물류 서비스를 제공하는 회사입니다. 글로벌 물류시스템, 고객 시스템과의 직접 연계, 맞춤형 물류 시스템, 다양한 EDI 연계 시스템 등 물류정보시스템을 통해 물류시스템을 개발/운영합니다. 또한 CIS 지역, 동유럽, 중앙아시아 및 중동에 철도 운송 서비스를 제공합니다. 내륙 운송 서비스; FCL/LCL, OOG, DG 화물, ISO 탱크 및 Flexi-bag을 포함한 다양한 유형의 배송으로 구성된 해상 운송 서비스; 수출입 화물에 대한 항공운송 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한, 해외/국내 화학공장, 발전소, 인프라 프로젝트 등의 장비 운송을 담당하고 있습니다. ISO 탱크 운영자 및 청소 창고 역할을 합니다. 또한, 내륙/물류 컨설팅 서비스를 제공합니다. 철도, 해상, 내륙, 창고 등 복합 운송 서비스
